# ROG Flow Z13 (GZ302) keyboard: reverse-engineering notes

Collected on 2026-10-19 from a GZ302EA running Kubuntu 26.04 (kernel 7.0), with the USB folio
keyboard `0b05:1a30`. The program that uses these findings is described in [README.md](README.md).

## Summary

- Fn on its own does not reach evdev. The Fn layer is built by the keyboard firmware: it already
  sends PgUp, Insert, media keys, etc. ready-made.
- Even so, the keyboard sends Fn to the system: on every key change, the ASUS interface sends a
  `5d 0a …` report with the map of **all** the physical keys pressed, Fn included.
- The hid-asus driver discards that whole report before hidraw and evdev, so no ordinary tool
  (evtest, hidraw, keyd) sees Fn. Only the HID debugfs file shows it.
- Tested with the keyboard backlight on and off: the map arrives the same.

## Folio interfaces

The `.00NN` suffixes change on every reconnection. What identifies each interface is the size of its
descriptor.

| Interface (capture) | Descriptor | Function | Driver |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.0012` | 192 bytes | ASUS vendor (page `0xff31`): reports `5a`, `02`, `03`, `5d`, `5e` | hid-asus |
| `.0013` | 77 bytes | vendor `0xff82` (reports `c1`, `c2`), probably lighting | hid-asus |
| `.0014` | 83 bytes | keyboard: report `01` | hid-asus |
| `.0015` | long | touchpad (mouse `01`, multitouch `54`, …) | hid-multitouch |
| `.0016` | long | LampArray (page `0x59`, Windows Dynamic Lighting) | — |

In evdev, `.0014` shows up as `event14`, and `.0012` has shown up as both `event15` and `event13`:
that numbering changes too.

## Report formats

### `.0014`, report `01` (33 bytes)

| Byte | Contents |
|---|---|
| 0 | ID `01` |
| 1 | modifiers: bit0 left Ctrl, bit1 left Shift, bit2 left Alt, bit3 left Meta, bits 4–7 the right-hand ones |
| 2 | reserved (constant) |
| 3–8 | up to 6 keys, one keyboard usage (page 0x07) per byte |
| 9–32 | 192-bit bitmap (usages 0x00–0xBF), used from the 7th simultaneous key onward |

### `.0012`

| Report | Size | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `5a XX` | 2 declared (the firmware sends 6 or 32) | an ASUS vendor code; `5a 00` means release |
| `02 LL HH LL HH` | 5 | up to two 16-bit Consumer usages; all zeros means release |
| `03 XX` | 2 | bit0 = Wireless Radio Button; bits 1–7 constant |
| `5d 0a …` | 32 | key matrix map (below); the descriptor declares a vendor "array" |
| `5e …` | 6 | not observed |

### What hid-asus does with this (kernel 7.0)

- `5d` and `5e`: discards them entirely in `asus_raw_event` (treats them as an Aura lighting "echo").
  This happens before hidraw and evdev.
- `5a` with byte 1 in `ea ec 02 8a 9e`: discards it (the "spurious" codes). On the Z13, `9e` and
  `8a` are Fn+C and Fn+V.
- `5a ae`: sends it to asus-wmi (fan profile) and blocks it, if asus-wmi accepts it.
- Unknown vendor codes: ignored ("ASUS lazily declares 256 usages").
- `KEY_KBDILLUMUP/DOWN/TOGGLE`: consumed by the driver itself (keyboard backlight).
- It binds only to the generic HID group; the touchpad is left to hid-multitouch.
- Fixes the `.0012` descriptor (`asus_report_fixup`, N-Key keyboards): the `95 05` right after
  `85 5a` becomes `95 01`. The sysfs descriptor (at the end of this file) already has the fix
  applied. The device's own descriptor declares 5 bytes in `5a`, so the reports arrive with 6.
  HID-BPF sees the original.

### Vendor codes (`5a XX`) that hid-asus maps

It ignores the others. Useful for remapping: injecting `5a XX` generates the key in the table.

| Code | Key |
|---|---|
| `10` / `20` | `KEY_BRIGHTNESSDOWN` / `KEY_BRIGHTNESSUP` |
| `35` | `KEY_DISPLAY_OFF` |
| `38`, `8b` | `KEY_PROG1` (ROG key, ProArt Creator Hub; on the Z13, Fn+Space) |
| `4b` | `KEY_F14` |
| `4e` | `KEY_FN_ESC` (Fn+Esc; on the Z13 hid-asus doesn't use it to lock Fn) |
| `5c`, `b3` | `KEY_PROG3` |
| `6a` | `KEY_F13` |
| `6b` | `KEY_F21` (toggles the touchpad) |
| `6c` | `KEY_SLEEP` |
| `7c` | `KEY_MICMUTE` |
| `7e` | `KEY_EMOJI_PICKER` |
| `82` | `KEY_CAMERA` |
| `88` | `KEY_RFKILL` |
| `92`, `b5` | `KEY_CALC` |
| `99`, `ae` | `KEY_PROG4` (`ae` goes through asus-wmi first: fan profile) |
| `b2`, `ba` | `KEY_PROG2` |
| `c4` / `c5` / `c7` | keyboard backlight: up / down / toggle (consumed by hid-asus) |
| `a5`–`a8` | `KEY_F15`–`KEY_F18` (ROG Ally) |

## Matrix map (`5d 0a`)

Bytes are counted from the report ID (`5d` is byte 0). Each cell is the key for that bit.
It comes from the "Fn + each key" captures and from the same sequence typed without Fn.

| Byte | `01` | `02` | `04` | `08` | `10` | `20` | `40` | `80` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 | | | | | | Esc | | F1 |
| 5 | F2 | F3 | F4 | | F5 | F6 | F7 | F8 |
| 6 | F9 | F10 | F11 | F12 | Del | | | |
| 7 | | | `` ` `` | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
| 8 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 | 0 | `-` | `=` | Backspace |
| 9 | | | | | | | | Tab |
| 10 | Q | W | E | R | T | Y | U | I |
| 11 | O | P | `[` | `]` | `\` | | | |
| 12 | | | | | Caps Lock | A | S | D |
| 13 | F | G | H | J | K | L | `;` | `'` |
| 14 | | Enter | | | | | | |
| 15 | | Left Shift | | Z | X | C | V | B |
| 16 | N | M | `,` | `.` | `/` | Right Shift | | |
| 17 | | | | | | | Left Ctrl (corner key) | **Fn** |
| 18 | | Left Alt | | Space | | | | |
| 19 | | Copilot | | ↑ | | | | |
| 21 | | | | | | | | ← |
| 22 | ↓ | → | | | | | | |

Bit `08` of byte 5 (between F4 and F5) has not appeared. Meta and the other keys on the bottom row
are still missing.

## Firmware Fn layer (with the physical Fn key pressed)

| Key | Firmware sends | Interface | Reaches the system as |
|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | `02 e2 00` (Consumer Mute) | `.0012` | `KEY_MUTE` |
| F2 | `02 ea 00` (Volume Down) | `.0012` | `KEY_VOLUMEDOWN` |
| F3 | `02 e9 00` (Volume Up) | `.0012` | `KEY_VOLUMEUP` |
| F4 | `5a 7c` | `.0012` | `KEY_MICMUTE` |
| F5 | `5a ae` | `.0012` | fan profile via asus-wmi (`KEY_PROG4` if asus-wmi is absent) |
| F6 | Meta, Meta+Shift, Meta+Shift+S (`0x16`) | `.0014` | Meta+Shift+S (screenshot) |
| F7 | `5a 10` | `.0012` | `KEY_BRIGHTNESSDOWN` |
| F8 | `5a 20` | `.0012` | `KEY_BRIGHTNESSUP` |
| F9 | Meta+P (`0x13`) | `.0014` | Meta+P (display switch) |
| F10 | `5a 6b` | `.0012` | `KEY_F21` (toggles the touchpad) |
| F11 | `5a c7` | `.0012` | keyboard backlight (consumed by hid-asus) |
| F12 | `03 88` | `.0012` | nothing: the radio bit is 0. The release comes as `5a 00` |
| ↑ | `0x4b` | `.0014` | `KEY_PAGEUP` |
| ↓ | `0x4e` | `.0014` | `KEY_PAGEDOWN` |
| ← | `0x4a` | `.0014` | `KEY_HOME` |
| → | `0x4d` | `.0014` | `KEY_END` |
| Del | `0x49` | `.0014` | `KEY_INSERT` |
| Enter | `02 92 01` (AL Calculator, `0x0192`) | `.0012` | `KEY_CALC` |
| Esc | `5a 4e` | `.0012` | `KEY_FN_ESC` |
| Space | `5a 38` | `.0012` | `KEY_PROG1` (ROG key) |
| C | `5a 9e` | `.0012` | nothing: hid-asus discards it |
| V | `5a 8a` | `.0012` | nothing: hid-asus discards it |
| `[`, `]` | nothing; only the matrix shows the key | — | nothing |
| Copilot | `0x65` (Application) | `.0014` | `KEY_COMPOSE` (Menu) |
| Backspace | `0x2a`, unchanged | `.0014` | `KEY_BACKSPACE` |
| Ctrl, Shift, Alt | unchanged | `.0014` | — |
| All other letters, numbers and symbols, Tab, Caps Lock | unchanged | `.0014` | the key itself |

Release: Consumer comes back as `02 00 00 00 00`, vendor as `5a 00`. Meta and the other keys on
the bottom row were not captured with Fn.

## Copilot key

- **Alone**, it is a firmware macro on `.0014`: `01 08` (Meta), `01 0a` (Meta+Shift),
  `01 0a 00 72` (+F23). It releases in reverse order: F23, Shift, Meta. In the matrix: byte 19, `02`.
- **Fn+Copilot**: `01 00 00 65`, Application/Menu (`KEY_COMPOSE`).
- To remap it in the future: the matrix reports the physical key on its own (byte 19, `02`), without
  the macro. On `.0014` it only appears as Meta+Shift+F23, which can't be told apart from someone
  actually pressing that shortcut.

## Other observations

- `5a ec 02 …` (32 bytes) arrives every ~3 s while keys are in use. The hid-asus driver discards it.
- Fn+F6 leaves Meta+Shift stuck until Fn is released. In the capture, the Fn+F9 that followed came
  out as Meta+Shift+P because of that.
- Fn+F12 (airplane mode) doesn't work on Linux: the firmware sends `03 88`, and the radio bit
  (bit 0) is 0. hid-asus would map the vendor code `0x88` to `KEY_RFKILL`, but it never comes in
  `5a`. The program injects `5a 88` on corner key + F12, and Plasma toggles airplane mode with it.
- Fn+Backspace has no function in the firmware.
- Fn on its own only shows up in the matrix (byte 17, `80`). Nothing is sent on `.0014`.
- The order between `.0012` and `.0014` for the same key varies; they arrive in the same millisecond.

## How to capture again

The HID debugfs file shows the reports before hid-asus filters them. It can be read with Secure Boot
on (it is mode 0400, read-only). Run it over SSH, so the Z13 keyboard doesn't type into the
terminal, and don't touch the touchpad:

```bash
sudo python3 tools/hid-capture.py
```

With the HID-BPF program loaded, debugfs shows the reports already transformed (the `5d 0a` echo
becomes `10 …`), because hid-core runs the BPF before writing to debugfs.

Descriptors (no sudo needed), and decoding them:

```bash
for d in /sys/bus/hid/devices/0003:0B05:1A30.*; do echo "== ${d##*/}"; od -An -tx1 -v -w32 "$d/report_descriptor"; done > rdesc.txt
python3 tools/hiddecode.py rdesc.txt
```
